title: My dream locations are weird.
content: I can definitely relate to this sub, but none of the locations in my dreams are nice places, like I’m seeing others talk about… I don’t always dream, but 99% of the time it’s in the same location. It’s some place where the landscape seems familiar, but none of the roads or buildings are right. I can describe it best as a map that would be in Grand theft auto/ Red dead. It often starts with me and a friend or coworker coming to this rural intersection on a nice 2 lane road… to the right there is a massive hill, it goes all the way up (about 2 miles) then you can go either way and follow the ridge around a bowl like mountain range for a huge area,( almost like it’s a crater) but this is the only route to the top, except for one town I get to sometimes. Sometimes, I get there and walk up the hill like (100ft) and get back on the main rim road. Or (back to the intersection) you can go straight, which seems like it leads into the bowl, and there are a few towns down there. Then also you can go left… it leads to an interesting little town up the hill on the side of the bowl… this is the one that you can walk a short distance and start back on the rim road. The weird thing is… none of it seems safe. I can lucid dream, but I never have control… and every building in every town is made of just wooden boards… like 1800s ghetto. Normally I get to some place, and the whole building has only natural light, which shines through the windows and also the crack’s between each board in the floors/ walls which are made of like wooden pallets,( it’s normally not a nightmare, but sometimes I’ll be in a 5-6 story building that’s made of wood like shipping pallets. The stairs always make me start sweating(irl) and I always have a reason to go up there, and often my friends will fall through the floor, but be ok and start over… I know it’s wild… but I never can figure out what we are doing there? I have done a lot of crazy things in this place, but I never understood the point. It’s a beautiful place, and I honestly think it’s a combo of things I see and one of my past lives… Any ideas from this community? Can anybody relate?
